source.note: This report describes the cited a0 main commit plus the current repo-owned plan. The 2026-08-17 PTCNA correction reclassifies a0's existing PTCNA region as a historical pre-audit scaffold integration and blocks intended PTCNA integration until UCNS produces neural-audit-derived construction evidence. The report commit itself does not change runtime, persistence, privacy, deployment, or upstream producer authority.

owns: a0 application runtime and promised agent-system delivery behavior
the Platonic Agent as a0's open maximal whole-agent object and the a0-owned mapping of existing agent semantics into distinct semantic regions
durable agent definitions, runtime-instance identities, run lineage, semantic-memory persistence, and owner-scoped service contracts as realizations within the Platonic Agent
a0-side bindings to ZFAE inference, historical PTCNA scaffold state, PCEA/Guardian privacy projection, provider routing, tool execution, and lifecycle behavior
resource-to-need matching workflow and consent-mediated disclosure behavior implemented by the platform
does_not_own: ZFAE conceptual ontology or inference-event semantics beyond a0's runtime binding
PTCNA architecture, UCNS neural-audit evidence, or future audit-derived tensor-state semantics
UCNS mathematical representation or proof status
skill-lib organization-wide build and cross-repository workflow doctrine
non_transfer: subsuming a producer-backed semantic region into PlatonicAgent does not transfer producer authority into a0
a provider model is an energy provider relation and does not become the agent identity
historical PTCNA scaffold state and semantic memory remain distinct regions and distinct merge-authority channels
the existing PTCNA scaffold region is not the intended PTCNA merely because a0 can persist and restore it
the sealed PTCNA scaffold falsification does not establish failure or success of a future audit-derived PTCNA
run artifacts are not semantic memory merely because they are produced by an agent run
global system-primary read authority does not imply disclosure authority
runtime integration does not transfer theorem, semantic, measurement, certification, or empirical status from producer repositories
published EULA language is not a substitute for executable privacy enforcement and tests

portfolio_role.summary: Deliver the a0 agent system by realizing bounded operational agents from an open Platonic Agent object while composing persistent identity, inference, runtime state, memory, tools, privacy, provenance, provider relations, lifecycle, and resource-to-need behavior without collapsing their distinctions or absorbing producer authority.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: a0 consumes exact upstream producer identities through bounded region bindings/adapters and keeps their authority separate from a0-owned whole-agent semantics. Intended PTCNA remains unavailable until its UCNS neural-audit prerequisite is satisfied upstream.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: a0 exposes operational agent definitions, instances, runs, scoped memory projections, tools, audited actions, interfaces, APIs, and deployment behavior as bounded realizations of PlatonicAgent regions.

reports_to.relation: repo-owned whole-agent, runtime, memory, privacy, delivery, and deployment-plan input; no authority transfer

status.state: active implementation; promised a0 delivery remains incomplete
status.current_claim: PlatonicAgent subsumes the presently legible a0 agent semantics as distinct executable regions. a0 can persist and restore the exact historical PTCNA scaffold state and routing receipts, but that region is now explicitly historical: the intended PTCNA has not been built and is BLOCKED until UCNS audits a functioning conventional neural network and PTCNA derives a new candidate from that evidence. The sealed scaffold role-acquisition result remains FALSIFIED for both usefulness and superiority on its exact tested scope. Other durable a0 regions remain incomplete.
